source: 外研社选必一 Unit 6 同主题完形(高原列车之旅/护林员与羚羊/申请珊瑚礁工作/帮助自然的假期/熊猫保姆的一天/守护白沙滩)。用词限 U6/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Journey on the Sky Railway
passages.text: Sitting back in my seat, I could hardly believe that I was finally riding the famous Sky Railway. For years people had told me this line was (1)____ to build, yet here it was, carrying me across the roof of the world. The train raced (2)____ across the high plateau, and the (3)____ outside my window was more beautiful than any photo. Soon we crossed a (4)____ bridge, the longest one ever built over frozen ground. Below it, a group of antelopes were eating grass at their (5)____, taking no notice of us. I learned that special passages had been left so that the animals could keep their (6)____ safe. Higher up, the air grew (7)____, and I felt a little dizzy. Luckily, oxygen was provided to help passengers stay (8)____. At Tanggula we reached the highest station on the whole (9)____. As I looked out at the snow and sky, I felt proud that workers had managed to (10)____ such difficult conditions to build this amazing railway.

passages.title: The Ranger and the Antelopes
passages.text: My name is Dawa, and for years I have worked as a ranger on the high (1)____, watching over the Tibetan antelopes. But the workers were (6)____ and changed nothing. Slowly, the antelopes began to trust the new crossings. Now they (7)____ across to the grassland to give birth, just as their mothers did. They hardly seem to (8)____ the trains that rush past above. Protecting their (9)____ has become my life's work, and it makes me proud. I truly believe that a great railway and healthy (10)____ can share the same land.

passages.title: Applying for the Reef Job
passages.text: When I saw the advertisement, I knew at once that I had to (1)____. A company was looking for someone to spend six months looking after the Great Barrier (2)____. passages.title: A Holiday that Helps Nature
passages.text: Last summer my family chose a very different kind of (1)____. Instead of lying on a busy beach, we joined an ecotourism trip that promised to (2)____ for nature rather than harm it. Our guide explained that this kind of tourism brings jobs and supports the local (8)____. Of course, the planes that carried us there still produced some (9)____, so the trip was not perfect. Even so, I came home believing that travel done this way gives people a real reason to (10)____ wild places instead of spoiling them.

passages.title: A Day as the Panda Nanny
passages.text: People call me the Panda Nanny, and I (1)____ after the pandas in a nature reserve in Sichuan. My day begins early, long before the visitors (2)____. passages.title: Should We Save White Beach?
passages.text: There is a heated argument in our city about White Beach. A company wants to build a large hotel there, and the owner is strongly in (1)____ of the plan.
